svg.title: Venus's heat path, in cross-section
svg.desc: Altitude to scale up to 80 km. Fans pull 737 K air through a chimney's exchangers; sealed liquid loops lift the heat to the Exhaust canopy at 65 km, which throws it to space as infrared light. The Braking Ring, 400 km up, takes the Lattice's beam and sends power down tethers. After 2036, heat pipes carry the floor heat up through the sealed dry ice.
